description: This Perl script creates a CA bundle file (ca-bundle.crt) by downloading and parsing Mozilla's certdata.txt, extracting CA root certificates, and converting them to PEM format. It includes logic for trust level filtering, certificate processing, and optional text output, with configuration options for certificate trust purposes, algorithms, and download methods.
